title: Open, read-only checks first
summary: Before building on them: cats2 Azure size and whether it allows nested virtualisation (KVM); the current state of xtpd and the fabrics on cats1, cats2 and ed209k; whether the Azure serial console works on cats2 (R2). Risks: skipping the rehearsal ladder makes node failures harder to diagnose (mitigated by logging every step from first boot and the journal of checked effects); disabling things at boot can lock cats2 out (acceptable only with rebuild recovery R5 and port 22 under R2).
authority: plan agreed by Tom Dyer (continue, 25 Nov 2026 15:04); hitlist Claude (Fable 5.2); review and writing Claude (Opus 5.5)
invariants: Read-only checks before building on assumptions
